NPC_AVIAN_IRON_BEAK.title: Iron-Beak Interrogator
NPC_AVIAN_IRON_BEAK.narrative_prompt: A tall, impeccably dressed avian stares at you in complete silence. They are waiting for a Yes or No.

mechanics.behavior: Never attacks physically first. Uses social combat to drain Composure.

social_tactics.The Binary Trap: Forces a [Logical] clash. If the player is evasive, the Iron-Beak inflicts 1d6 Composure Trauma.

NPC_IRON_FORGE_DANCER.title: Forge Dancer
NPC_IRON_FORGE_DANCER.narrative_prompt: A silent, heavily scarred lizard-folk steps forward, their movements a fluid, instantly deadly dance.

clash_logic.HOLD: Unyielding: If they win a HOLD tactic, attacker takes 1d4 thermal recoil damage.

mechanics.zero_state_breach: Never yields ground. If Stamina hits 0, they immediately trigger a final [Brutal] attack before collapsing.

NPC_SUMP_SLITHER_GUARD.title: Slither-Guard Cavalry
NPC_SUMP_SLITHER_GUARD.narrative_prompt: A slick Frog-Kin emerges from the muck, riding a massive, venomous Water Moccasin and leveling a lever-action rifle.

clash_logic.MANEUVER: Toxic reposition. Mount applies [Poison] to anyone in the previous zone.

NPC_GREY_WARDEN_FIST.title: Warden of the Fist
NPC_GREY_WARDEN_FIST.narrative_prompt: A grey-robed ascetic draws two locking scimitars. The metal threads in their robe begin to glow with sickly chaos radiation.

clash_logic.PRESS: Death Storm: 2d6 [Slashing]. Uses Focus instead of Stamina to fuel attacks.
clash_logic.DISENGAGE: Sigil-Thread Discharge: Leaves a localized [Hazard] of pure Chaos in the zone.

mechanics.zero_state_breach: Kamikaze Run. If HP reaches 0, the Warden detonates their internal chaos, dealing 4d10 [Aetheric] damage to the entire zone.

NPC_GUERRILLA_SHADOW_PAW.title: Shadow Paw Operative
NPC_GUERRILLA_SHADOW_PAW.narrative_prompt: A tiny, cloaked feline drops silently from the canopy, an explosive-tipped crossbow bolt already loaded.

clash_logic.DISENGAGE: Leap-Charm: Instantly moves 50ft vertically to escape the clash.

NPC_SCIURINI_STEWARD.title: Sciurini Guild Steward
NPC_SCIURINI_STEWARD.narrative_prompt: The immaculate Squirrel butler adjusts his monocle as the explosion rocks the room. He brushes a speck of dust from his tailcoat, draws a reinforced silver serving tray, and steps between you and the assassin.

clash_logic.MANEUVER: Graceful Deflection: Steward uses their reinforced serving tray to parry, gaining [Momentum] and draining 2 Focus from the attacker.
clash_logic.TRICK: Surgical Scalpel: 1d8 [Piercing]. Target gains [Bleed]. Uses Focus instead of Stamina to strike.

mechanics.zero_state_breach: If Focus drops to 0, the Biomancy enhancement fails. The Steward loses [Precise] and becomes [Staggered].

NPC_RAT_CANE_MASTER.title: Strand Auditor
NPC_RAT_CANE_MASTER.narrative_prompt: A tall Rat in flowing silk robes and ruby-tinted goggles steps into the den. The rhythmic clicking of his beaded head-tassels fills the sudden silence.

social_tactics.The Click: Uses rhythmic beads to mesmerize. Forces an [Intuition] check; failure results in the target gaining the [Distracted] tag before combat begins.

clash_logic.PRESS: Hidden Stiletto: 1d10 [Piercing]. Triggers instantly from the hollow cane.

NPC_OTTER_FOG_SINGER.title: Delta Krewe Fog-Singer
NPC_OTTER_FOG_SINGER.narrative_prompt: An Otter in a heavy, waterproof trench coat begins to hum a low, dissonant chord. Instantly, a thick, unnatural river fog rolls over the docks, swallowing the light.

clash_logic.DISENGAGE: The Shroud: Singer vanishes into the mist, applying [Obscured] to the entire Zone. Ranged attacks against them suffer severe Disadvantage.
clash_logic.HOLD: Current Manipulation: Singer shifts the water beneath the target's feet, applying the [Unstable] tag.

NPC_TARSIER_SNIPER.title: Ghost-Eye Auditor
NPC_TARSIER_SNIPER.narrative_prompt: You don't hear the shot. You only see the massive, unblinking eyes of the tiny Tarsier rotating 180 degrees in the canopy above as your commander drops dead.

clash_logic.PRESS: Long-Eye Jezzail: 2d10 [Piercing]. Subsonic round; completely silent. Target cannot use [Reactive] tags to defend.
clash_logic.MANEUVER: Vertical Spring: Instantly leaps 15ft vertically to re-establish stealth.

mechanics.zero_state_breach: The Tarsier relies entirely on distance. If engaged in a melee Clash Lock, all their actions suffer Disadvantage and cost double Stamina.

NPC_WOLVERINE_GUARD.title: Brotherhood Sentinel
NPC_WOLVERINE_GUARD.narrative_prompt: A stout, muscular Wolverine stands before the door. Their leather muzzle-plate bristles with multi-colored strings that snap like a chaotic mane as they draw their weapons.

clash_logic.HOLD: The Empty Room: Refuses to yield the Zone. Anyone attempting to Move past them is automatically dragged into a Clash Lock.

mechanics.zero_state_breach: Indifferent Loyalty. If Composure hits 0, they do not panic. They fight to the death to fulfill the contract, gaining [Enraged] but remaining immune to [Compelled: Flee].
